lines: You text first after every argument.
She says she’s okay, you hear her sigh.
Your phone buzzes, you reply right away.
She’s already planning her next day, you’re still stuck.
You think texting proves you care.
It just shows you don’t want to be alone.
Follow for more daily psychology that can change your life.

caption: Loving yourself means letting go of the “first responder” habit. Share if you’ve recognized it.
